description: Live adversarial test: fires malformed/garbage/fake payment proofs at a target to see if any trick it into returning 200 without a real payment. Requires payment (0.05 USDC on Base, x402) -- NOT callable for free over MCP. Calling this tool returns the exact HTTP request to make instead; it does not run the check itself. See GET /conform?url=... on this same origin.

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of the paid endpoint to check (should return HTTP 402).

name: conform_x402_endpoint
